caption: The video captures a low-angle close-up of a Newton's cradle in front of a man in a bright yellow-green shirt, his face framed through the metal support against a blurred ceiling with fluorescent light strips. A row of polished spheres hangs from strings and oscillates continuously, with two outer spheres blurring into motion while the remaining three spheres stay clustered with little visible movement. The moving pair alternates between the left and right sides of the frame, swinging toward the vertical posts and returning inward while the resting group remains centered. The man behind the cradle repeatedly opens his mouth, smiles, widens his eyes, and tilts his head slightly. The view stays largely fixed, keeping the frame, lights, and spheres dominant while the back-and-forth transfer of motion continues without a visible start or conclusion.
